summary: Phase 1 backend + frontend testing complete. 27/27 pytest backend tests passed covering auth (login, register, wrong-password, logout, forgot-password generic response, reset-password token flow), RBAC (member/reviewer forbidden on structure/assign), project CRUD, structure CRUD with optimistic concurrency (stale rev → 409), assignments with member validation + board grouping + mine filter, chunked resumable version upload → complete → immutable version_number, download via Bearer and ?auth=, review pass/fail flow with returns list, stale-version force=true guard (409 without force), script manual import → diff (added vs exists) → confirm (additive only, double-confirm 409), audit list + restore of update reverts before-state, RBAC forbids audit for member, dashboard aggregation. Frontend E2E on Chromium: login → dashboard stats (Dự án 2 / Tổng shot 6 / Chờ duyệt 1) → open DEMO-01 → Structure (4 sequences, scenes, shots) → shot sheet with tab-versions/tab-review/tab-assign + upload-version-btn + save-assign-btn → Board → Script manual import + confirm → Members → Audit timeline with restore buttons all working.

issues: Console warning: `DialogContent` requires a `DialogTitle` for accessibility (screen readers). Add a VisuallyHidden DialogTitle in ShotSheet.jsx or the modal dialogs used inside the sheet.

action_items: (Minor A11y) Add a hidden DialogTitle (Radix VisuallyHidden) in the Dialog components that lack one — reproducible when opening the shot sheet / new-scene / new-shot dialogs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py CORS uses allow_origins=[FRONTEND_URL, 'http://localhost:3000'] with allow_credentials=True — good. CORS_ORIGINS='*' in .env is unused; consider deleting to avoid confusion.
auth.py check_lockout does not clear on password reset via IP-scoped identifier — but /auth/reset-password does delete login_attempts by email, matching playbook. OK.

download_version accepts token via ?auth= query string, which is convenient for <video> tags but logs the JWT in access logs. Consider signed short-lived download URLs or a per-version download token in a later phase.
versions.py stores uploads on local disk (/app/.uploads) before pushing to storage — good for chunking; ensure cleanup on failed complete (currently only cleaned on success).
structure.py update_shot's ShotUpdate does not include status field, but /shots/{id}/status endpoint exists — good separation. However clients need to know which path to use.
scripts.py confirm always creates a new sequence 'SEQ-IMP' even if all scenes are duplicates and 0 created — leaves an empty sequence; consider skipping seq creation when created==0.
audit.py restore for 'update' does not increment rev via $inc; it sets rev = before.rev+1 which can conflict if concurrent updates happened — low priority.
reviewer role has 'review.decide' but not 'version.upload' — correct. Member role has version.upload but not review.decide — correct per RBAC matrix.
auth_routes register endpoint returns 200 (should ideally be 201 for resource creation) — minor REST style.
No rate limit on /auth/register; only /auth/login has brute-force lockout. Consider adding registration throttling.
